about: Tactical frame T shows the same moment as broadcast frame B = (T - a) / (1 + b), for T in [from, to). The mapping fits the offsets between the provided ball tracks in 10-second windows. The offset slips about one frame over each half. The broadcast drops most of half-time: it leaves the first half at B 84796 and joins the second-half clock at B 86545, so tactical frames in between have no broadcast.
